# bob-ota

Over-the-air firmware updates: the signed release bundle, the server firmware module (releases, channels, offers, download) and the device OTA policy, manifest parser and client.

## You own

- `apps/api/src/firmware/**`
- `apps/cardputer/{src,include}/ota_*`
- `apps/cardputer/src/state_update.cpp`
- `apps/cardputer/include/fw_keys.h`
- `scripts/release/fw-*`
- `docs/cardputer/ota-*`

## Your tests

- `apps/api/tests/firmware/**`
- `apps/cardputer/test/host/test_ota_*.cpp`
- `scripts/release/fw-*.test.mjs`

## Read first

- `docs/cardputer`
- `.claude/skills/bob-dev/references/shared-hardware.md`: check who holds COM3 and :7444 first.

## Gates you must run

- `npx vitest run --root apps/api tests/firmware`
- `npm run test:firmware`
- `npm run device:compile`
